title: Mind Space (Standard)
description: Continuing the trend of pushing the envelope of hypnosis based trance experiences with "A Happy Little Orgasm" and the "L.A.T.E.X" Series; this is the experimental brainchild of my broken minion. A guided meditative journey into the great expanse of space and your mind. Mixing music, tantric meditation, hypnosis and yes, even a little bit of singing from yours truly (be gentle, haha). Hypnosis can be quite something. It can take you places, do things to you that you never thought possible. Open doors in your mind that had been jammed shut for years, decades even. Or it can take you places that your physical body can’t, like being dropped into a vivid dream or fictional story, carried along, being swept away... Just relax for me... Although I would love to join you in person for this journey. I am afraid you will be the only passenger, but rest assured I’ll still be here the whole time, it’s perfectly safe, trust me. You are going to be my test pilot for the maiden voyage of a new experimental experience. It’s been named the D.R.O.N.E programme. And I promise, it’s going to be something special indeed. Because after all... You are just a Drone... I am just a Drone... I am just a Drone...
author: Mistress Shibby
